title: [Phase 6] Integrate mitmproxy-grid-java-client SDK into Testara

2. Add dependency management entry for io.github.ygrip:mitmproxy-grid-java-client
3. Add SDK dependency to testara-ui/pom.xml
4. Replace imports in:
   - AbstractProxy.java
   - MitmProxySeleniumUtility.java
   - MitmProxyPlaywrightUtility.java

title: [Epic] Extract MitmProxy Grid Java client to standalone SDK
description:
Extract the MitmProxy Grid client implementation from testara-ui into a dedicated repository: git@github.com:ygrip/mitmproxy-grid-java-client.git

- Backward-compatible Testara migration path

title: Add LLM provider abstraction and configuration to testara-agent
description:
LLM provider abstraction layer for agentic skills that require language model reasoning.

Interface:
  LlmClient: complete(LlmRequest) -> LlmResponse

Implementations:
- OpenAiLlmClient: OpenAI-compatible HTTP (gpt-4.1-mini default)
- LocalLlmClient: Ollama/local model support
- DisabledLlmClient: stub for tests and read-only skills

Configuration (properties + env vars):
  testara.agent.enabled=true
  testara.agent.provider=openai
  testara.agent.model=gpt-4.1-mini
  testara.agent.api-key=${TESTARA_AGENT_API_KEY}
  testara.agent.temperature=0.2
  testara.agent.max-context-files=80
  testara.agent.max-output-files=20
  testara.agent.apply-enabled=false

Security defaults:
- API key only from env var, never hardcoded
- Never log prompt payload by default
- Redact secrets (password, token, authorization, api-key, cookie, session, private-key) before sending
- Do not send .env, credentials, private keys

Priority (CLI > env vars > testara-agent.yaml > configuration.properties > defaults)

title: [Phase 4] Implement /test-run skill — NL tag resolver and safe Maven execution
description:
Accept natural-language input, resolve to Cucumber tag filter, execute tests, generate concise report.

Core components:
- TagFilterResolver: deterministic priority — explicit tags > known aliases > exact index match > domain match > semantic LLM inference > ask for clarification
- TestRunPlanner: dry-run output (resolved expression, matched features, scenario count, Maven command)
- TestRunExecutor: safe Maven command builder — only fixed templates allowed, block shell injection (&&, ||, ;, pipes, backticks, )
- CucumberReportParser: parse JSON report + JUnit XML fallback + Maven console fallback
- TestRunReportBuilder: concise Markdown + machine-readable JSON

CLI flags:
  testara-agent /test-run 'input' [--dry-run] [--execute] [--report markdown|json|html] [--rerun-failed]

Allowed Maven command templates only:
  mvn test -Dcucumber.filter.tags='{expr}'
  mvn verify -Dcucumber.filter.tags='{expr}'
  mvn -pl {module} test -Dcucumber.filter.tags='{expr}'

Configurable: tag-alias config (smoke=@smoke,@sanity; critical=@P0,@critical; etc.)

Acceptance criteria:
- Resolves explicit tags directly
- Resolves common aliases (smoke, regression, api, ui, critical)
- Shows matched scenario count before execution
- Runs Maven safely with tag filter
- Produces clean concise report with failed scenario details
- Supports rerun failed

title: [Phase 2] Implement /test-review skill
description:
Review a feature path or step definition directory and detect quality issues.

Detection rules:
- Duplicated / near-duplicate scenarios
- Overlapping coverage
- Inconsistent terminology
- Weak or missing assertions (no meaningful Then)
- Missing negative paths
- Excessive setup repetition
- Unstable/random data usage
- Inefficient feature organization
- Low-value / redundant tests

Output structure:
- Findings grouped by severity (BLOCKER, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, INFO)
- Suggested Background extraction
- Suggested Scenario Outline conversion
- Suggested command/validation reuse
- Priority recommendation (P0-P4 per scenario)
- Optional patch proposal mode

CLI: testara-agent /test-review <path> [--format markdown|json]

Acceptance criteria:
- Finds exact duplicate scenario names
- Finds similar step sequences
- Flags scenarios with no meaningful Then
- Suggests Background or Scenario Outline extraction
- Produces scenario priority recommendations

title: [Phase 1b] Implement /test-summary and /test-overview skills (read-only)
description:
First two user-facing agentic skills, both read-only with no LLM required.

/test-summary:
- Summarize feature/scenario/directory
- Extract: business behavior, preconditions, tags, data tables, Testara commands used, validators used, risk/priority inference, gaps
- Output: structured Markdown and JSON
- CLI: testara-agent /test-summary <path> [--scenario 'name']

/test-overview:
- Whole-project stats: feature count, scenario count, tags distribution, domain breakdown, step definition coverage, missing steps, duplicate candidates, avg steps/scenario, longest scenarios, most used fixtures/specs/validations
- Export formats: markdown (default), json, html
- CLI: testara-agent /test-overview <path> [--format json|markdown|html]

Both skills must be pure deterministic extraction — no LLM calls in this phase.

Acceptance criteria:
- Can summarize a single feature file
- Can summarize a feature directory
- Can count features/scenarios/tags accurately
- No LLM provider required

title: [Phase 1] Add testara-agent and testara-agent-cli module skeleton with core indexers

description:
Bootstrap new Testara automation projects or integrate Testara into existing Maven projects.

title: [Phase 5] Implement /test-plan interactive feature generator
description:
Generate Testara-friendly Cucumber feature files grounded in the actual project index.

Behavior:
- Interactive mode: ask follow-up questions (layer type, target service/page, coverage scope, data expressions, tags, request spec)
- Placement strategy per layer: API (features/api/{domain}/), UI (features/ui/{domain}/), Database, Streaming
- Generate .feature file, request spec JSON, validation JSON
- Generate missing-step report
- Default to patch mode — require --apply to write files
- Keep generated files traceable with header comment

Guardrails (critical):
- Feature syntax must be valid Gherkin
- Scenario names must be unique in target directory
- Only use known step definitions or explicitly mark as MISSING
- Command expressions must be syntactically valid
- Validation tags must exist or generated validator is included
- No secrets generated into files

CLI:
  testara-agent /test-plan 'intent' [--interactive] [--slice api|ui|database|streaming|fullstack] [--patch] [--apply]

Acceptance criteria:
- Does not hallucinate existing steps (marks unknowns as MISSING)
- Generates valid Gherkin
- Places files in correct directory per slice convention
- Can generate both API and UI slices

title: [Phase 3] Implement /test-command and /test-validation generation skills
description:
Two code generation skills producing Testara-compatible Java classes and JSON files.

/test-command:
- Parse user description to infer: command name, aliases, return type, parameters, cacheability
- Generate Java class implementing CommandLogic<T> with @CommandTag
- Generate JUnit unit test
- Generate README usage snippet
- Suggest scan-location property update if package is outside defaults
- Output placement: src/test/java/.../commands/{Name}Command.java

/test-validation:
- Mode 1: generate validation JSON using existing validators (EQUAL, NOT_EQUAL, CONTAINS, SORTED, etc.)
- Mode 2: generate custom ValidatorLogic<ACTUAL, EXPECTED> Java class when existing validators insufficient
- Decision logic: prefer JSON mode, generate Java only for domain-specific needs
- Leverage existing validator catalog: EQUAL, NOT_EQUAL, EMPTY, NOT_EMPTY, CONTAINS, CONTAINS_TEXT, STARTS_WITH, ENDS_WITH, MATCH_PATTERN, HAS_SIZE, GREATER_THAN, LESSER_THAN, IN_RANGE_OF, SORTED, CONTAINS_KEY, MATCH_SCHEMA, MATCH_PATTERN

Acceptance criteria:
- Generated command compiles
- Generated validator compiles
- Generated validation JSON is structurally valid
- Suggested scan-location config is correct for generated package
